prompt:
The chart below shows the average number of hours worked each week in five types of work in one country in 2002 and in 2022.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Average weekly working hours in five types of work, 2002 and 2022
visual.alt: A bar chart comparing average weekly working hours in five types of work for 2002 and 2022.

key_points: Weekly working hours fall in four of the five sectors; the only exception is information services, which rises from 38 to 40 hours
Farming remains the sector with the longest hours in both years (48 → 43 hours), so the top of the ranking does not change
The biggest fall is in manufacturing: 6 hours (44 → 38); the smallest fall is in building work: 3 hours (45 → 42)
The bottom of the ranking changes places: in 2002 the shortest hours were in information services (38 hours), but by 2022 this position belongs to shops and cafés (34 hours)
The gap between sectors narrows slightly: the 10-hour range in 2002 (38-48) falls to 9 hours in 2022 (34-43)
Looking at the 40-hour threshold, three sectors were above it in 2002; in 2022 only two remain above it, one sits exactly at 40 hours, and two are below
common_mistakes: Overlooking the one exception (the rise in information services) and saying 'all sectors fell'
Listing the two years separately instead of comparing the change and the shift in ranking between them
Confusing hours with percentages ('working hours fell by 6%')
Giving an opinion ('shorter hours are better for workers') — not allowed in this task
Describing only the highest and lowest bars and never mentioning the three sectors in between
topic: weekly working hours by type of work
